marquee.purpose: h1 only, every page: hero headline, page-hero banners, 404.

display.purpose: h2-h4: section headings, card titles, tier/package names and prices.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, letters, benefit lists, nav labels.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Broad ambient marigold wash behind lit elements.

shadows.name: bulb
shadows.purpose: Primary button glow (bulb-halo ring + warm drop).

shadows.name: stall
shadows.purpose: Default stall-card ink-black diffuse drop shadow at rest.

motion.name: twinkle
motion.purpose: String-light bulb glow animation, per-bulb staggered delay.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill button, marigold-to-saffron gradient, ink text, bulb glow. Single primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffd166, #ff7f0d); color: #1a1023; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,194,51,0.28), 0 8px 24px -4px rgba(255,127,13,0.45); transition: filter 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,194,51,0.4), 0 10px 28px -4px rgba(255,127,13,0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined translucent pill for second-priority CTAs on the dark ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 2px solid rgba(255,192,109,0.5); color: rgba(255,248,237,0.9); padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; backdrop-filter: blur(6px); transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #ffc06d; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: White-filled outline pill used on light stall-card surfaces for non-featured tier/package CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid rgba(109,23,160,0.3); background: #ffffff; color: #4c1170; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #6d17a0; background: #fdf5ff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a1fc9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stall Card
components.description: Signature container: scalloped canvas-awning top trim (CSS mask) over a saffron-lit surface with ink text. Reused for sponsor tiers, vendor packages, and hero entry cards.
components.css: .ds-stall-card { position: relative; border-radius: 1.75rem; background: #fff8ed; color: #1a1023; box-shadow: 0 20px 45px -20px rgba(8,2,16,0.6); padding: 28px 24px 24px; } .ds-stall-awning { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: 0; height: 14px; transform: translateY(-1px); background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #ce4805 0 22px, #ff9d32 22px 44px); -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 11px 0, transparent 10px, black 11px); mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 11px 0, transparent 10px, black 11px); -webkit-mask-size: 22px 16px; mask-size: 22px 16px; -webkit-mask-repeat: repeat-x; mask-repeat: repeat-x; border-radius: 1.75rem 1.75rem 0 0; } .ds-stall-card h3 { font-family: 'Baloo 2', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; } .ds-price { font-family: 'Baloo 2', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 28px; margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Price-Tag Pillar
components.description: Hanging price-tag clip-path card with a colored string above it; used for the three Mission pillars in place of a plain icon-card grid.
components.html:
Inclusive by design

A community-centred celebration.
components.css: .ds-price-tag-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding-top: 36px; } .ds-string { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 32px; width: 2px; height: 28px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9d32, rgba(255,157,50,0.2)); } .ds-price-tag { clip-path: polygon(15% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 15% 100%, 0% 50%); background: #1f0e2b; border: 2px solid rgba(255,157,50,0.33); padding: 28px 24px 28px 40px; color: #fff8ed; box-shadow: 0 20px 45px -20px rgba(8,2,16,0.6); } .ds-price-tag h3 { font-family: 'Baloo 2', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text input with diya-purple border at rest, saffron glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 2px solid #f6e6ff; background: #ffffff; color: #1a1023; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #635a6e; } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: #ff7f0d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,192,109,0.6); }

components.name: Navbar Active Link
components.description: Nav link with a glowing marigold bulb-dot beneath the active item, driven by scroll-spy IntersectionObserver on Home anchor sections.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,248,237,0.8); transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #ffd166; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #ffd166; } .ds-nav-bulb { position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); height: 6px; width: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffd166; box-shadow: 0 0 10px 3px rgba(255,209,102,0.75); }

components.name: String Lights Strand
components.description: Procedurally generated sagging-wire SVG strand of twinkling bulbs; used at the top edge of the hero, page-hero banners, 404, and the navbar bottom edge.
components.html: <svg class="ds-string-lights" viewBox="0 -6 800 56" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0,0 Q400,42 800,0" fill="none" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.55)" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="400" cy="42" r="4.5" fill="#ffd166"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.55;1;0.55" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle></svg>

narrative.overview: The site is the night market itself, caught at rest just before the crowd arrives: a near-black ink-night ground strung with warm saffron and marigold fairy-light bulbs, lit stalls (sponsor tiers, vendor packages, team pillars, the sponsor/vendor letters) glowing against the dark, and hand-lettered marquee signage announcing the event. This replaced a generic purple-gradient-hero-plus-three-icon-cards template; the explicit rejection is that arrangement, not gradients or purple as such — the incumbent diya-purple hue survives as a supporting tone (night-sky glow, one Mission pillar accent, outline-button color) rather than the dominant identity. Every recurring UI motif earns its place by literally existing in a night market: string-light strands do the job a plain rule or divider would elsewhere; bulb-glow (not gray box-shadow) is the interactive/focus affordance; stall-card components carry a scalloped canvas-awning top exactly where a card would otherwise have a plain edge. The system is asymmetric and hand-set rather than gridded-and-centered — pillars and stall cards tilt, lift, and settle back on hover, matching a market stall rather than a SaaS dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ink-night ground with warm saffron/marigold light as the only source of "glow"
Bungee marquee display type reserved strictly for h1 — every page banner and 404 gets one hand-lettered marquee moment
Stall-card as the one recurring container shape, reused for sponsor tiers, vendor packages, and letters
String-lights and bunting strips as literal, animated (twinkling) section dividers, not abstract line rules
Asymmetric, tilted composition (rotated cards, staggered "hanging" pillars) in place of a centered grid

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Gray Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in this system is a tinted light source (shadow-glow, shadow-bulb, shadow-lantern: all marigold/saffron rgba glows) or an ink-black diffuse drop (shadow-stall). Neutral gray box-shadow never appears; depth reads as light, not as material lift.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: Text is either saffron-tinted white on the ink-night ground, or ink-dark on a saffron-50 lit surface (stall-cards, price-tags, fields). No third neutral gray text/background pairing is used.

rules.name: The One-Marquee Rule
rules.body: Bungee is scoped to h1 only, globally, via the base stylesheet (h1 { @apply font-marquee }) rather than per-component classes — it is structurally impossible for a body paragraph or a card title to pick up the marquee face by accident.

rules.name: The Lit-From-Within Rule
rules.body: Elevation never uses a neutral gray shadow scale. An element is either glowing (warm, colored, used for anything interactive or featured) or sitting in ink-black shadow (used for static stall-cards at rest).

dos: Do reuse the stall-card as the single container for any tiered, packaged, or lettered content (sponsor tiers, vendor packages, outreach letters) rather than introducing a new card shape.
Do reserve the Bungee marquee face for h1 only, one per page.
Do tie all shadow/glow to the saffron/marigold hue family (or ink-black for resting stall-cards); never introduce a neutral gray shadow.
Do keep StringLights/BuntingStrip procedurally generated (SVG, no bulb/flag image assets) so hue and count stay tokenized and reduced-motion-safe.
Do keep the logo (/logo.jpg) exactly as shipped, wrapped only in the LanternGlow/ring treatment in Logo.tsx — the mark itself is fixed, not a placeholder.
donts: Don't use the marquee (Bungee) face for body copy, card titles, or labels — it is an h1-only device, confirmed by the global h1 { @apply font-marquee } rule.

Don't introduce event photography; no photo library exists for this first-ever running of the festival, and the system is built to carry that absence gracefully through pattern, light, and typography instead.
Don't apply the stall-card--diya (purple awning) variant outside vendor-context cards — it is a deliberate sponsor/vendor color distinction, not a random alternate skin.
Don't treat the diya-purple family as the dominant brand hue going forward — it is the retained supporting/incumbent tone; saffron and marigold carry the identity now.
